modules.content:
Our Services

From eviction cleanouts to deep cleaning — we handle it all with integrity and professionalism.

modules.title: Eviction Junk Removal
modules.description: Complete property cleanouts after eviction. We remove all debris, abandoned belongings, and hazardous materials, leaving the unit turnover-ready.

modules.title: Deep Cleaning Services
modules.description: Professional deep cleaning for post-eviction, move-in/move-out, and property rehabilitation. Every surface sanitized and restored.

modules.title: Furniture & Appliance Removal
modules.description: Heavy items hauled away responsibly. Couches, mattresses, refrigerators, washers — we handle the heavy lifting so you don't have to.

modules.title: Property Cleanout
modules.description: Full estate or rental property cleanouts. We clear everything from attic to basement efficiently and dispose of items responsibly.

modules.title: Debris & Construction Cleanup
modules.description: Post-renovation and construction debris removal. Drywall, lumber, tile, flooring — removed and hauled to proper disposal facilities.

modules.title: Yard Waste & Outdoor Cleanup
modules.description: Overgrown yards, fallen branches, old fencing, and outdoor junk cleared to improve curb appeal and property value.

modules.content:
How It Works

Getting started is easy. Three simple steps to a clean property.

modules.title: Book Your Estimate
modules.description: Call us or fill out our online form. We'll schedule a free, no-obligation on-site estimate at a time that works for you.

modules.title: We Do the Work
modules.description: Our professional crew arrives on time, removes all junk, and performs deep cleaning as needed. We handle everything from start to finish.

modules.title: Property Ready
modules.description: Once we're done, your property is clean, sanitized, and ready for new tenants, sale, or renovation. We even do a final walkthrough with you.

modules.content:
Why Choose T&C Integrity?

We built our reputation on doing things right — with honesty, hard work, and attention to detail. When you hire T&C, you get a team that treats your property like their own.

  • Fully licensed, bonded, and insured
  • Background-checked, professional crew
  • Eco-friendly disposal and recycling
  • Transparent, upfront pricing — no surprises
  • Same-day and emergency service available
  • Serving property managers, realtors, and homeowners
Get Your Free Estimate

What Our Clients Say

Don't just take our word for it — hear from the property managers and homeowners we've served.

modules.author: Sarah M.
modules.body: T&C handled an eviction cleanout for me and had the unit turnover-ready in less than 24 hours. Professional, thorough, and affordable. They're my go-to from now on.

modules.author: Marcus J.
modules.body: I've used several junk removal companies and T&C is by far the best. Their deep cleaning service is top-notch — the apartment looked brand new when they were done.

modules.body: After my mother passed, T&C helped clear out her house with care and respect. They donated what they could and disposed of the rest responsibly. I can't thank them enough.
